status.title: Still early. Actively improving.
status.description: This project is in its early days. The AI isn't as sharp as I want it yet, and some interactions still feel rough — bear with me.

cta.greeting: I'm Joey Zhao, an indie developer exploring the space where AI meets productivity. Gotly Keeper is a small tool I'm building — no grand ambitions, I just wanted to solve my own problem first, and maybe help others along the way.
cta.feedback: If you try it and feel it solves a problem for you, or fits a need you've had, let me know. If something sucks, tell me that too —
